_note: Hand-labeled resolver ground truth for CHICAGO. Added in the Phase-11 correction, when _CHICAGO_REGIONS gained 15 community-area boxes covering the 44.5% of segments that previously fell to the compass fallback. Chicago had NO label set before this, so its resolver was never gated. `expected` is one of: a region label exactly as _CHICAGO_REGIONS emits it, lowercased; 'sensor:<id>' meaning 'resolves to exactly that segment' (the validator's prefix is domain-neutral; Chicago nodes are road SEGMENTS); or null meaning 'must NOT resolve'. Labeled from Chicago community-area geography BEFORE measuring.
_why_the_nulls_matter: The refusals encode the failure modes this correction found. (a) DIRECTIONS ARE NOT PLACES: 'northwest of the Loop' is a bearing, not a community area, and must not collapse onto a real region — the collapse that let a citation of the target's own sector score as a causal hit. Note 'NW of the Loop' IS a legitimate label for the 8.4% of segments still on the compass fallback, so it resolves; the spelled-out bearing does not. (b) OUT-OF-CITY: Chicago's footprint stops at the city limits, so suburbs and other cities' landmarks must not resolve. (c) EXPRESSWAYS are linear facilities spanning many community areas, not nodes.
